product.title: Blossom Gold
product.description:
Let your Nikkah day bloom into a keepsake. Blossom Gold is a personalised resin wedding plaque with a luminous pearlescent white base, a scalloped gold-tone edge and floral arrangements in vivid pink, soft blush and cream. Gold-tone flakes and pearl-style accents frame your names and wedding date, making it a meaningful centrepiece for your ceremony and a beautiful reminder afterwards.

Design details

  • Pearlescent white resin with a softly textured, light-catching finish.
  • Raised floral details arranged around the edge in pink, blush and cream.
  • A scalloped gold-tone border with scattered gold-tone flakes and pearl-style embellishments.
  • Personalised names and wedding date. The sample features gold-tone Arabic calligraphy, an English translation and burgundy names.
  • Available in 8-inch, 10-inch and 12-inch sizes.

Personalise your plaque

Choose your size and enter your names and wedding date using the product options. Select your preferred wording and available text options, checking spellings, dates and Arabic text carefully before checkout. Names and dates shown in the photos are examples and will be replaced with your details. For a different flower colour palette or a specific verse, contact us to confirm availability before ordering.

What is included?

The displayed price is for the personalised plaque only. Handles and ring holders / ring boxes are optional paid add-ons and are not included in the base price. Choose available accessories separately to complete your set.

Production and delivery

Each Blossom Gold plaque is handmade to order. Please allow 7–10 working days for production, plus delivery time. If your event date is approaching, check availability with us before placing your order. Slight variations in floral placement and resin patterns are part of the handmade finish.

Care

Dust gently with a soft cloth and handle the raised floral details carefully. Avoid soaking, abrasive cleaners, excessive heat and prolonged direct sunlight.

Need help with your wording, colour preferences or event date? Chat with us on WhatsApp for assistance, then complete your order through checkout.

Design details

  • Glossy burgundy base with swirling tonal patterns.
  • Textured red border with gold-tone accents.
  • Pearl-style embellishments around the edge.
  • Personalised gold-tone lettering.
